sources.register: Institutionsregisteret, Styrelsen for IT og Læring (instreg.stil.dk)

København.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for other places (dagtilbud, fritidsinstitution/KKFO/fritidshjem); no sibling subsidy for klub or private fritidsinstitution.
København.note: The same price applies to fritidsinstitution and KKFO. July is free. The page lists no separate morning price and no grade-specific price.

Frederiksberg.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the others (applies to dagtilbud, private pasning with subsidy and SFO 1; not to klubber or private school schemes).
Frederiksberg.note: SFO 1 rate; the SFO rate is the same in the 1 Jan 2026 and 1 May 2026 takst PDFs. Payment is collected monthly in advance. Neither the page nor the PDFs say whether July is free, so months is null.

Gentofte.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% sibling subsidy on the other places; granted up to and including 5. klasse.
Gentofte.note: The SFO is called GFO in Gentofte (2025: 2,170 kr.). July is free. The page lists no separate morning price.

Gladsaxe.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% off the other places (dagtilbud, SFO and skoleklub); none for private school schemes.
Gladsaxe.note: 2,103 kr. for SFO 0.-3. klasse, including 0. klasse (rate period 1 Jan-31 Dec 2026). The pages found do not say whether July is free. Sibling rule from gladsaxe.dk/.../friplads-og-tilskud.

Lyngby-Taarbæk.siblingDiscount: 50% of the parent payment on the place(s) where the municipal subsidy is lowest; covers dagtilbud, SFO and fritids-/ungdomsklub.
Lyngby-Taarbæk.note: Rate from 1 April 2026 for SFO børnehaveklasse-3. klasse. July is free for residents using a place in LTK. No separate morning price listed.

Hvidovre.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the other places (vuggestue, børnehave, kombineret institution, SFO1); none for klub/SFO2/SFO3 or private school SFO.
Hvidovre.note: SFO1 (0.-3. klasse). Explicitly billed in all 12 months; only SFO3 has July free. No separate morning price listed.

Rødovre.siblingDiscount: Sibling subsidy per dagtilbudsloven §43 (most expensive place at 100%, further places at 50%); for SFO it applies up to and including 6. klasse; none for private SFO.
Rødovre.note: SFO I (0.-3. klasse). July is free. Morning opening is included in SFO I; no separate morning price. The 100%/50% split is from the rk.dk dagtilbud takst page; the SFO page only confirms that a sibling subsidy exists.

Tårnby.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for other places; does not apply to klubber.
Tårnby.note: Rate from 1 April 2026 (after the 2026 lowering of the parent share). The page does not say whether July is free. Caveat: dragoer.dk's cross-border table lists 1,852 kr. for Tårnby SFO, which seems to reflect Dragør's own rate.

Dragør.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% of the payment for other places (dagtilbud or SFO); none for private SFO or klub.
Dragør.note: 'Taksterne opkræves over 12 måneder'; payment also due during holidays. Morning opening from 06:30 at some SFOs, no separate price. Also on dragoer.dk/boern-og-unge/dagtilbud-0-6-aar/takster-for-boernepasning.

Herlev.siblingDiscount: Full rate for the most expensive place, 50% discount for sibling places.
Herlev.note: LOWER CONFIDENCE: herlev.dk blocks automated fetch (Cloudflare 403). Values come from search-engine excerpts of this herlev.dk page: SFO 2,253 kr./month; rates billed monthly, with July free for SFO and klub. Needs a manual check.

Brøndby.siblingDiscount: Not stated on the SFO page (only fripladstilskud is described)
Brøndby.note: The page says 'Takster for 2025 og 2026 pr. måned SFO: 1.929 kr. (0.-3. klasse)' and 'Der skal ikke betales for juli'. Every SFO opens in the morning from 6:30 to 8:00, and no separate morning price is given. A linked PDF 'pr. 1. september 2025' shows 1.854 kr. for 2025, which doesn't match the page.

Glostrup.siblingDiscount: 50% of the parent payment, given on the cheapest places (siblings in dagtilbud, SFO or klub)
Glostrup.note: The SFO page says 'skolefritidsklub er 1.857 kr. om måneden i 2026', which looks like a wording slip. SFO covers 0.-3. klasse, and 3. klasse leaves on 31 March. Whether July is free was not found.

Ballerup.siblingDiscount: 50% discount on the oldest children (dagpleje, daginstitution, private care). Doesn't apply to byggelegeplads/klub or ungdomsklub. The page doesn't say explicitly whether BFO is covered.
Ballerup.note: SFO is called BFO (Ballerup FritidsOrdning), ages 6-9. The price is 1.898 kr. both from 1 Jan and from 1 Apr 2026, and was 1.745 kr. in 2025 (takst PDF). Whether July is free was not found.

Albertslund.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the others
Albertslund.note: SFO1 costs 2.013 kr. in 2026 (1.952 kr. in 2025). The page says 'alle takster afregnes alle 12 måneder'. No split by grade.

Rudersdal.siblingDiscount: Most expensive rate + 50% of the following rates
Rudersdal.note: SFO covers 0.-3. klasse, 2.290 kr. from 1 Jan 2026 (2.215 kr. in 2025). July is free for residents who use SFO in Rudersdal.

Furesø.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive child, 50% of the rate for each following child
Furesø.note: SFO is called FFO. FFO 1 (0.-3. klasse) costs 2.207 kr. in 2026 (2.141 kr. in 2025). Whether July is free was not found.

Vallensbæk.siblingDiscount: Full rate for the most expensive place, half price for the others (siblings must share an address; not for junior/ungdomsklub)
Vallensbæk.note: SFO covers 0.-4. klasse, 1961 kr. per month in the 2026 table. The 2026 cut applied only to daycare, and SFO has no 'ny takst'. Whether July is free was not found.

Ishøj.note: Low confidence: ishoj.dk is behind a Cloudflare challenge (403), so the page couldn't be read directly. The figures come from a search-engine summary of this official page: SFO1 (0.-3. klasse) 1.561 kr./month, SFO2 660 kr., July free. Rates are listed before sibling discount and friplads.

Høje-Taastrup.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% for the following places (SFO included; klub and private-school SFO excluded)
Høje-Taastrup.note: SFO costs 1.917 kr. in 2026 (1.860 kr. in 2025), and 'juli er betalingsfri måned'. The pre-school SFO for April-June (before 0. klasse starts) costs 2.261 kr. The sibling rule is from htk.dk/borger/dagtilbud-og-skole/dagtilbud/tilskud-til-pasning-af-boern.

Hørsholm.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the other places
Hørsholm.note: The price covers Børnehaveklasse-3. klasse; 4.-6. klasse costs 1.215 kr. July is free, except for places across the municipal border, which are billed for 12 months.

Morning care ('Morgenåbent') costs 150 kr/month, but a full SFO monthly price for 0.-3. class was not found on the pages checked. If a student withdraws mid-year, fees are due for the withdrawal month plus the following month.

schools.name: Krebs' Skole
schools.profile: Classic Copenhagen private school founded in 1872, emphasizing a solid academic foundation in a secure setting, with numerous long-standing school traditions.
schools.waitlist: For 0. class, waitlisted families receive a letter in September the year before school start to confirm interest; classes composed by following January. For grades 1-9, vacancies trigger an initial orientation conversation with school leadership, followed by an intake interview with Danish/math teachers before admission.

fees.siblingDiscount: None - "Der ydes ingen søskendemoderation" (no sibling discount offered)
fees.notes: SFO pricing is tiered: morning care (07:00-08:35) 470 kr/md; afternoon care (13:40-16:00) 1,420 kr/md; extended afternoon (13:40-17:30) 1,710 kr/md; minimum monthly SFO payment is 940 kr. A 3,000 kr deposit is required at enrollment (in addition to no sibling discount, one of the pricier options among the six schools on a per-month basis when deposit is included).

news.title: Krebs' Skole
Coronafrygten får konsekvenser på københavnsk skole: Sætter stopper for mangeårig tradition

schools.name: Sankt Annæ Skole
schools.profile: A Catholic private school on Amager, founded in 1897 by Redemptorist priests under Bishop von Euch. This institution (sanktannaeskole.dk) is NOT the music/choir profile school - that is Sankt Annæ Gymnasium (sag.dk), a separate, unrelated public/municipal institution in Valby famous for its choirs. Sankt Annæ Skole does run its own small in-house 'musikskole', but its defining identity is Catholic, and admission explicitly prioritizes Catholic applicants and siblings.
schools.waitlist: Registration on the waiting list costs 300 DKK. Class composition is finalized roughly one year before school start, with priority given to siblings and Catholic applicants, then by seniority (with attention to gender balance). Students not admitted can remain on the waitlist for 100 DKK/year.

fees.siblingDiscount: 3rd child: 1,075 kr/month (500 kr reduction vs. 1st/2nd child); 4th child: free, as long as all four siblings are enrolled simultaneously.
fees.notes: Fees billed in 12 monthly installments, due the 5th of the month. 10th grade billed separately at 2,400 kr x 10 installments. SFO is 1,400 kr/month over 12 installments, with May and June free for 3rd-graders. Enrollment fee of 1,000 DKK is charged only once a spot is offered (separate from the 300 DKK waitlist registration fee). Fee is stated to include several field trips (2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th grade trips, including Bornholm and Rome). IMPORTANT: do not confuse with Sankt Annæ Gymnasium (music/choir school) - a different institution.

schools.name: Bordings Friskole
schools.profile: A Grundtvig-Kold friskole (Danish independent free school in the Grundtvig-Kold tradition) with grades 0.-9. klasse, roughly 420 pupils across two parallel tracks (as of Sept 2024).
schools.waitlist: Admission to grades 1-9 goes through an electronic waitlist (ventelisten.net). Kindergarten (0. klasse) has about 44 places per year, with priority for siblings.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,545 kr/month; 3rd child: 515 kr/month. Discount only applies if fees are paid by the same parent (and, for half-siblings, if they share a registered address).
fees.notes: 9th grade is billed differently: 2,248 kr/month over 11 installments (July is fee-free after exams), instead of the standard 12-month schedule. Enrollment fee of 200 DKK is an administrative charge for joining the waitlist, not a one-time indskrivning fee.

schools.name: Den Lille Skole i København
schools.profile: A small free school ('lilleskole') located in Brønshøj, Copenhagen, and a confirmed member of Lilleskoleforeningen, the Danish association of reform-pedagogy free schools (in the tradition of e.g. Nørrebro Lilleskole, Østerbro Lilleskole). Grades and detailed pedagogy statement could not be independently confirmed on the school's own site during this research.
schools.waitlist: Joining the waiting list costs a non-refundable 600 DKK administrative fee. A separate non-refundable 3,500 DKK enrollment fee is charged after an admission interview once a place is offered.

fees.siblingDiscount: A sibling discount is offered per the school's own materials, but the exact percentage/amount could not be confirmed.
fees.notes: The school's fee page (on skoleporten.dk, linked from lilleskolen-kbh.dk) returned HTTP 403 to direct automated fetching; the figures above were recovered via a search-engine snippet of that exact page ('Den Lille Skole i København - Opskrivning og priser') and could not be re-verified directly or dated to a specific school year - recommend confirming directly with the school before relying on these numbers. Monthly school fee: 2,035 kr over 12 months. SFO/'fritidshjem': 1,724 kr/month over 11 months (no charge in July). Do not confuse with the separate, differently-named 'Den Lille Skole' (no 'i København'), which has different fees (~2,130 kr/month school, ~1,340 kr/month SFO) and is a different institution.

external.notes: NOT CHECKED: school website is hosted on skoleporten.dk, which returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot challenge) to curl and WebFetch ; www.lilleskolen-kbh.dk returns HTTP 409. Needs manual browser check for tilsynserklæring, UMV and whether the school sits FSA.

schools.name: N. Zahles Seminarieskole
schools.profile: One of several independent primary schools operating under the shared 'N. Zahles Skole' name/heritage (tracing back to Natalie Zahle's 1851 girls' school and the 1895 teacher-seminary practice school). Academically classic/traditional, co-educational since the 1950s, with stated values of democracy, equality, creativity, community, tradition, dialogue and responsibility; daily morning singing is a school ritual.
schools.waitlist: Website references an 'Indskrivning' (enrollment) process; specific waitlist length/criteria were not found.

fees.siblingDiscount: No sibling discount is offered as of 1 August 2025 (previously offered, now discontinued).
fees.notes: IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION: 'N. Zahles Skole' / zahles.dk is a shared portal/brand for legally separate institutions: (1) N. Zahles Seminarieskole (seminarieskolen.zahles.dk) - this institution, id 101088, a standalone grundskole (0.-9. klasse) descended from the seminary's practice school; (2) N. Zahles Grundskole, run as the 'Grundskoleafdeling' of N. Zahles Gymnasieskole (grundskolen.zahles.dk) - a separate primary school with its own institution number (101155, covered separately in this dataset, sharing identical published fee figures); (3) N. Zahles Gymnasium (gymnasiet.zahles.dk) - separate upper-secondary (STX) school. Fee also includes 28 kr/month parent-council charge and 50 kr/month fruit scheme; a 75 kr/month surcharge applies if not paying via PBS direct debit.

schools.name: Sankt Petri Skole
schools.curriculum: German (Thuringia) curricula grades 0-9 combined with Danish Folkeskole requirements; German Gymnasium standards grades 10-12
schools.waitlist: From grade 1 children must speak German. Waiting lists at all grade levels; admission not guaranteed; school leadership selects when oversubscribed.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 2,300 kr/month; 3rd child: 1,725 kr/month; 4th child and beyond: free.
fees.notes: 1st child DKK 2,625/month (31,500/yr), 2nd 2,300, 3rd 1,725, 4th+ free. SFO/Hort DKK 1,850/month (20,350/yr); Klub DKK 900/month. Fee reduction on application by 1 September.

schools.name: Østerbro Lilleskole
schools.profile: A free school ('fri grundskole') in the Danish reform-pedagogy 'lilleskole' tradition (confirmed member of Lilleskoleforeningen), emphasizing community, creative/practical/musical learning, and project-based, interdisciplinary teaching. Grades 0.-9. klasse, with roughly 22-24 pupils per class.
schools.waitlist: As of the research date, the school listed a few open spots for the 2026/27 school year (e.g., 3rd grade girls, 8th grade, and two anticipated 7th-grade spots); families are asked to contact the school directly for current waitlist status.

fees.siblingDiscount: 25% discount on the youngest child's fee when siblings are enrolled together.
fees.year: 2024/25 (last rate confirmed on the school's own site, effective from 1 August 2024)
fees.notes: The 2,980 kr/month egenbetaling (own-payment) figure is an ALL-INCLUSIVE fee covering school, SFO/club, and field trips for younger grades - there is no separate published SFO line item, hence sfoMonthlyDKK is null (bundled, not absent). Billed over 11 months (no charge in July). A 1,000 DKK non-refundable enrollment fee and a 6,000 DKK deposit (credited toward the family's final months of attendance) are also charged at enrollment. The site states fees rise annually per Denmark's net price index with a 2.5% minimum increase, so the true current (2025/26 or 2026/27) monthly fee is likely somewhat higher than 2,980 kr, but no more recent figure was published on the site as of this research.

schools.name: Hovedstadens Privatskoler, Filipskolen
schools.profile: Christian free school (kristen friskole) on Amager Strand, member of the Association of Christian Free Schools (FKF); over 50 years old, ~200 students grades 0-9. Open to all regardless of church affiliation; values Christian faith, formation ('dannelse'), learning and well-being.
schools.waitlist: Waiting list open from birth for børnehaveklasse (0th grade), which starts May 1 each year; registration fee 500 DKK. Mid-year transfers into existing classes possible via screening + 2-4 week trial period.

fees.siblingDiscount: Fee decreases per additional child: tuition grades 0-3 ranges 1950 (1st child) down to 1350 DKK/month; grades 4-9 ranges 2050 down to 1450 DKK/month. SFO/club full-time 1225 (1st child) down to 1125 DKK; part-time flat 975 DKK.
fees.notes: Fees are tiered by grade band (0-3 vs 4-9) and by sibling order (1st/2nd/3rd child); page explicitly labeled these as 2025/2026 prices (site had not been confirmed updated for 2026/27 as of research, Sept 2026). September billing includes an extra 250 DKK contribution to the class fund. Withdrawal mid-year incurs the withdrawal month's fee plus one additional month. The dedicated 'Skolepenge.html' page on the school's SkolePorten subdomain (filip-skolen.skoleporten.dk) returned server errors (403/500) throughout research and could not be directly verified; figures above come from the 'Bliv elev' (Become a pupil) page on the main site.

schools.name: Amager Lilleskole
schools.profile: A 'lilleskole' (progressive alternative free school) on Amager with ~300 students, grades 0-9 (mostly single-track). Strong emphasis on community, artistic-creative subjects (music, choir, textiles, art, drama, PE, swimming), and project-based/thematic teaching, including whole-school annual projects and workshop weeks. Runs an attached music school (ALMUS).
schools.waitlist: Waiting list system with cohort-by-cohort status; lists for children starting 2020-2022 were closed (full); lists for 2023/2024/2025 starts were open with roughly 100/85/30 children registered respectively at the time those figures were posted. No 2026/2027 status was found on the page (site may not yet reflect current cohort), so current waitlist length is uncertain.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 562 DKK/month reduction; 3rd child: 1125 DKK/month reduction (applied to the flat 2440 DKK/month tuition).
fees.notes: Tuition (Bh.kl-9. klasse) is a flat rate, not tiered by grade; rate is adjusted annually on 1 January (current rate '1,940->2,440' effective 1 Jan 2026, i.e. spans the second half of school year 2025/26 and first half of 2026/27). SFO/'Klubben' (Bh.kl-3) is billed over 11 installments (Aug-June) rather than 12. Extra costs: ALMUS music program 50 DKK/month; camp/study trips 800-3,500 DKK depending on grade/destination; 7-9 grade music/theater festival ~1,000 DKK. Late payment fee 100 DKK + interest; early withdrawal without notice penalized 3 months' tuition+club fees. Payment only via Betalingsservice (direct debit).

schools.name: Byens Skole
schools.profile: A 'lilleskole' (progressive free school) in Valby with 450+ students across two tracks, grades 0-9. Pedagogy blends academic competence with development of students' critical thinking, motivation, personal expression and agency; draws on learning-by-doing and anti-authoritarian progressive-education traditions.
schools.waitlist: School maintains waiting lists; has a dedicated 'Indmeldelse - udmeldelse og ventelister' (enrollment/withdrawal/waiting lists) page. Both an enrollment fee and a separate waiting-list fee are charged; exact current wait times not stated on the fee page.

fees.siblingDiscount: None found/mentioned.
fees.notes: Fees are tiered by grade band: 0-3 = 1,765 DKK/month; 4-6 = 1,870 DKK/month; 7-9 = 2,635 DKK/month. SFO (0-3) = 870 DKK/month; 'Klub' (4-6) = 765 DKK/month (no club/SFO listed for 7-9). Fees stated as effective '1. august 2025'; the school's stated policy is a 3% increase each August, so 2026/27 rates are likely slightly higher but an updated page could not be found as of research (Sept 2026). Deposit at enrollment equals one month's tuition/SFO payment, in addition to the 1,000 DKK non-refundable enrollment fee. Fees are stated to cover schooling, books/materials (excluding dictionaries, calculators, computers), field trips/lejrskole, and a meal ('madordning') arrangement.

schools.name: Øbro Fri Skole
schools.profile: Montessori-inspired free school in a courtyard setting in Østerbro ('Østerbros hyggeligste baggårdsskole'), founded by teachers drawing on Maria Montessori's ideas about building children's self-confidence and sense of responsibility. Small, close-knit school with open classrooms, motto 'Live life - Learn life', strong emphasis on teacher-student relationships, security and anti-bullying culture.
schools.waitlist: Open enrollment with multiple spots currently available in 0. klasse (kindergarten class) and some vacancies in other grades; waiting-list registration for incoming 0. klasse via MitID at ventelisten.net. School holds open-house events/school visits for interested families.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 500 DKK/month reduction on tuition.
fees.notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: The school's own fee page (on the skoleporten.dk subdomain) returned repeated errors (HTTP 403, then 500) on every direct fetch attempt during this research; the figures above come from a search-engine cached snippet of that page, dated 'as of 1 January 2025'. Given today's date (Sept 2026), these figures may be outdated (the school may have since updated rates); they could not be independently re-verified. Camp school (lejrskole) costs are billed separately, not included in the monthly fee. Grades offered listed as '0-8' based on found references (student quotes up to '8. klasse'); it is possible the school actually extends further and this simply reflects available page content - treat as unconfirmed. Recommend contacting the school directly to confirm current fees before making decisions.

schools.name: Landsbyskolen
schools.profile: Independent Danish free school ('friskole') founded in 1974, non-affiliated with any religious or political movement, ~145 students, grades 0-9. Emphasizes respect for each pupil's individuality/abilities, small classes, community responsibility, and a daily 'Læsebånd' (dedicated reading period). Recognized by CEPOS for strong academic value-added. Became a fully independent self-governing institution in August 2023.
schools.waitlist: Waiting list open from birth; registration fee 300 DKK plus 100 DKK/year to remain listed (charged Sept/Oct). Siblings get priority; ~16 children accepted per kindergarten class, with gender balance considered. Currently only a few open spots exist, in 8th grade. NOTE: the school had no 0th-grade ('0. klasse') intake in 2023/2024, which means there is correspondingly no 1st class in 2024/25, no 2nd class in 2025/26, no 3rd class in 2026/27, etc. - i.e. a gap moves up through the grades; families registered for those specific cohorts could get waitlist-fee refunds.

fees.siblingDiscount: Sibling discount available but conditional on concurrent enrollment of siblings ('Søskenderabat er betinget af samtidig skolegang'); non-first children pay 1,650 DKK/month vs 2,000 DKK for the first child (exact discount mechanism/amount not further itemized).
fees.notes: Enrollment cost of 5,900 DKK breaks down as: 4,000 DKK deposit (= 2 months' tuition) + 1,900 DKK one-time enrollment fee. Fees billed monthly in advance over 11 months (not 12). Means-tested fee subsidies available based on prior year's tax return, must reapply annually. Camp/school-trip ('lejrskole') fees charged separately, ranging ~50-650 DKK/month depending on grade, spread across tuition bills. Figures above are explicitly labeled by the school as applying to school year 2026/2027.

schools.name: Nørrebro Lilleskole
schools.profile: Free school ('fri grundskole') in the Nørrebro lilleskole tradition, humanistic and critical pedagogical outlook, ~200 pupils grades 0-9 organized into cross-grade tiers: Stjerneskuddet (0-3), Nymånen (4-6), Fuldmånen (7-9), plus Galaksen SFO (0-3 after-school program). Emphasis on 'forpligtende fællesskaber' (binding/committed communities).
schools.waitlist: Annual information evening for prospective 0th-grade families each Oct/Nov (next one stated as 3 November 2026); class composition decided in November. Admission priority: siblings first, then waiting-list seniority. Classes capped at 20 pupils (kindergarten class starts with up to 24). Waiting list for existing classes must be reconfirmed annually by email or the family is removed.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: tuition 1,612.50 DKK/month (537.50 DKK discount), SFO 1,050 DKK/month (350 DKK discount). 3rd+ child: tuition 1,075 DKK/month (1,075 DKK discount), SFO 700 DKK/month (700 DKK discount). Waitlist fee (500 DKK) is waived for siblings of current pupils.
fees.notes: Fee period explicitly stated on page as running 1 Aug 2026 - 31 Jul 2027 (i.e. current, 2026/27 rates). Unlike some peer schools, camp/lejrskole contributions are already built into the monthly school fee rather than billed separately. Registration/enrollment: 1,000 DKK one-time enrollment fee plus a separate 500 DKK waitlist fee (waived for siblings). Families may apply for government means-tested subsidy ('Fripladsordning').

schools.name: Freinetskolen
schools.profile: A small independent 'lilleskole' in Valby, Copenhagen, following Freinet pedagogy (after French educator Célestin Freinet) with child-centred, workshop-based learning, ecological values, and school democracy (plenum meetings).

fees.siblingDiscount: Up to 25% reduction on fees for the 3rd and subsequent child in families with 3+ children enrolled simultaneously, applied via the school's internal reduction fund.
fees.notes: Fee is tiered by grade: kindergarten class (0.) through 3rd grade = 2,275 DKK/month (used here, applies to 1st grade); 4th-9th grade = 2,775 DKK/month. Fee includes mandatory organic/ecological lunch. Billed 12 months/year, last payment in July. Separate 'Pasning' (before/after-school childcare, SFO-equivalent) = 500 DKK/month for 12 months. Enrollment deposit = 2 months' ordinary fee (currently 5,550 DKK), refunded on withdrawal. 2 months' written notice required to withdraw. Prices page appears to show a rate increase effective 1 April 2026 (previous rate was 2,175/2,675 per an earlier cached search snippet).

schools.name: Vanløse Privatskole
schools.profile: A private primary/lower-secondary school ('privatskole') in Vanløse, Copenhagen, offering instruction from kindergarten class through 9th grade. No distinctive pedagogical movement (e.g. Freinet, Montessori, Grundtvig-Kold) was found described on available pages; appears to be a general/traditional Danish private school with an after-school club called 'Labyrinten'.

fees.notes: Could NOT find published fee figures despite extensive search. The school's real site (www.vanloeseprivatskole.dk / vanloeseprivatskole.dk) redirects into a Skoleporten-hosted portal (vanloeseprivatskole.skoleporten.dk); the specific 'Skolepenge.htm' and 'Værd at vide.htm' pages both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated fetching (likely blocked/JS-gated), and third-party aggregators (privateskoler.dk, skolegang.dk, kobenhavnliv.dk price-comparison article) reference the existence of fee info but did not surface the actual numbers in accessible text. Confirmed via skolegang.dk that the school teaches through 9th grade (203 students, average exam grade 9.6/12, well above national average). Do not guess the fee — recommend contacting the school directly (adm.101135@vanloeseprivatskole.dk / 38 71 56 85) or viewing the Skolepenge page in a real browser. Not to be confused with the separate, differently-named 'Vanløse Friskole' (vanloesefriskole.dk), which is a different institution.

fees.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for other places (dagtilbud, fritidsinstitution/KKFO/fritidshjem); no sibling subsidy for klub or private fritidsinstitution.

schools.name: Trekronergade Freinetskole
schools.curriculum: Danish (Folkeskolens Afgangsprøve after 9th grade); English taught from grade 3, German from grade 6
schools.profile: A small Freinet-pedagogy school centrally located in Valby, Copenhagen (210 students), emphasizing both academic and creative development of 'the whole child' through democratic, age-integrated workshop-based learning (groups named Ild, Jord, Luft for grades 1-6). Mobile-phone-free school.
schools.waitlist: Kindergarten-class admission is via lottery draw held in November; one-time waitlist registration fee of 300 DKK for grades 1-9.

fees.siblingDiscount: Sibling reduction available for families with 3+ children enrolled simultaneously (amount not specified); the one-time enrollment fee is halved for siblings (500 DKK vs 1,000 DKK).
fees.notes: Flat monthly fee of 2,275 DKK stated (no grade tiers mentioned, unlike sister-tradition Freinetskolen in Valby which tiers by grade at the same 2,275 DKK rate for grades 0-3). Fee is said to cover all materials, after-school program access, annual trips (grades 1-9), and a travel/music festival for grades 7-9 — so SFO appears to be bundled into the fee rather than charged separately (could not confirm a separate SFO price). Number of monthly billing installments per year not explicitly stated on the page (paid via PBS); left as null rather than assumed. Separate one-time kindergarten-class deposit of 3,000 DKK (refunded when the child leaves). Financial aid/subsidy applications available via the school office.

schools.name: Ryparken Lille Skole
schools.profile: A Copenhagen 'lilleskole' (reform-pedagogy free school) in the Ryparken/Østerbro-Nørrebro area, founded in 1983 by teachers and parents, with the motto 'Lev livet' (Live life). Emphasizes democracy and student meetings, the 'Mantle of the Expert' teaching method, and theatre as part of the curriculum.
schools.waitlist: Operates an admissions/waitlist system for kindergarten-class entry; specific acceptance rates or current waitlist length not published.

fees.siblingDiscount: Roughly 55% reduction for siblings: 1,012 DKK/month (grades 0-3) or 1,246 DKK/month (grades 4-7), versus the full 2,280/2,539 DKK rates.
fees.notes: Fee is tiered: grades 0-3 = 2,280 DKK/month (used here, applies to 1st grade); grades 4-7 = 2,539 DKK/month. Billed in 12 installments per school year. Note the school only goes through 7th grade (confirmed via enrollment-by-class-level data: classes exist for levels 0-7 only, ~173-560 students depending on source/year), so pupils transfer elsewhere for 8th-9th grade — unusual among the schools researched. Enrollment fee 1,750 DKK is non-refundable.

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynserklæring 2025/26 (supervisor Bent Laub Faaborg, 28 May 2026): skilled, committed teachers delivering age-appropriate, differentiated teaching; well-functioning school environment; Danish, maths and English and overall provision meet folkeskole standards; prepares pupils for democracy; teaching language Danish.

external.notes: Small lille skole; observed classes up to 7th grade and UMV questionnaire covered 3.-7. kl., so it appears not to run to 9th grade (no FSA results found). fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: -400 DKK/month; 3rd child: -600 DKK/month; 4th child: -900 DKK/month; 5th child: -1,400 DKK/month (all relative to the 1,550 DKK base rate).

schools.waitlist: No formal waitlist; annual application window (Sept-Dec) for the following August start; entrance assessment/interview Feb-March; admission decisions Mar-Apr. fees.notes: School fee billed 12 months/year including July, via PBS only. One-time deposit of 4800 kr (~3 months' fee) in addition to the 1000 kr enrollment fee (charged once per child for their whole time at the school). Material costs 700 kr charged twice yearly (Aug + Jan); class fund 700 kr in November. 9th grade is a special case: its annual fee (19,200 kr, i.e. same as 1600x12) is instead spread over 11 monthly payments of ~1745.45 kr rather than 12.

schools.name: Hay Skolen
schools.profile: 'HAYSKOLEN - en levende skole' ('a living school'), a private free school in the Sydvestkvarteret area of Copenhagen SV. No explicit religious affiliation or named pedagogical tradition (Grundtvig-Kold, Montessori, etc.) was found on the school's own site — appears to be a general, non-denominational lilleskole-type friskole, but that tag is a best inference rather than a confirmed label.
schools.waitlist: Admission tested/decided 4x/year (weeks 35, 50, 14, 25). Priority: (1) siblings registered by Oct 1 before the school year starts, (2) waitlist time (days since birth registered), balanced for gender mix, (3) school-readiness testing; final call by the headmaster. Apply via ventelisten.net/101181.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child 1600 kr/md (225 kr less than 1st), 3rd+ child 1350 kr/md (450 kr less).
fees.notes: Billed 11 installments Aug-June (July fee-free). SFO: 2nd+ child 600 kr/md each. Førskole (pre-0.klasse) 2500 kr/md incl. SFO 7:30-17:00. Summer SFO 600 kr/week. On top of the 1500 kr enrollment fee there is a 3700 kr deposit (~2 months' tuition, refundable on withdrawal after 0.klasse if paid up) and a separate 300 kr waitlist administration fee. Class trip surcharges: grade 5 Bornholm trip 400 kr x3, grade 8 international trip 400 kr x11. Prices are indexed annually each Aug 1, rounded to nearest 50/100.

schools.name: Sjællands Privatskole
schools.profile: Friskole in København NV (Nattergalevej), ~200 pupils, grades through 9th; notably diverse student body (41.3% with 'foreign background' in 2023/24 vs ~15% nationally), suggesting an immigrant-community-oriented friskole, but no specific religious affiliation (Muslim, Christian, etc.) or pedagogical tradition (Montessori, Waldorf, etc.) could be confirmed from any accessible source.

fees.notes: DOMAIN VERIFICATION: spsnet.dk is confirmed to be Sjællands Privatskole's genuine website — it iframe-redirects to spsnet.skoleporten.dk, and contact details there (phone 3833 4727, email sps@spsnet.dk, Nattergalevej 32) match official records for institution 101184, so the domain is correct, NOT misidentified. However, spsnet.skoleporten.dk is protected by a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge that blocked automated fetching, so the school's own priser/skolepenge and optagelse pages could not be read directly. The 800 kr/month (8800 kr/year) figure and grade range instead come from a third-party news comparison article and general directory listings (uddannelsesstatistik.dk, dingeo.dk, skoleliste.eu) — none state a school year for the fee explicitly; 8800/800=11 suggests 11-month billing but this is inferred. No SFO price, enrollment fee, sibling discount, or explicit pedagogy/religious profile could be found anywhere accessible. Recommend the parent visit spsnet.dk directly in a real browser (passes the Cloudflare check) or call 3833 4727 to confirm current tuition and profile.

schools.name: Mariendal Friskole
schools.profile: Small Copenhagen friskole (independent primary school) for grades 0-9 (bornehaveklasse to 9. klasse, ~132 pupils). Secondary sources describe a values profile centered on safety, anti-bullying and 'livsduelighed' (life skills) with a stated Christian worldview, but this could not be confirmed on the school's own site.

fees.notes: The school's own website (www.mariendalfriskole.dk, plain http, and its skoleintra/skoleporten subsites) could not be reached despite many attempts (SSL handshake failure, expired/mismatched certificate, and finally connection refused on port 443) — the site appears to be down or blocking automated fetches. No current fee figures could be found anywhere online. A third-party blog (pressenet.dk) references a 2016/17 enrollment fee of 1,500 kr and a c. 2017 monthly fee around 1,370 kr (noting fees are typically index-regulated, +10-20 kr/yr), plus a 'Christian worldview' description — these are unverified secondary-source claims only, not confirmed on an official page, so they were NOT used for the numeric fields. Grades 0-9 and pupil count confirmed via the Ministry of Education's uddannelsesstatistik.dk page. Recommend contacting the school directly (33 22 72 20 / kontoret@mariendalfriskole.dk) for current pricing.

schools.name: Al-Huda Skolen
schools.profile: Al-Huda Skolen is an Islamic private school (friskole) in Copenhagen NV, grades 0-9 (founded 1996), teaching the standard Danish curriculum alongside Arabic language, Quran and Islamic studies, while explicitly emphasizing integration into Danish society, a 'moderate' interpretation of Islam, and rejection of extremism.
schools.waitlist: Admission requires submitting a profile/readiness description from the current institution plus an admission interview/assessment; the school states Arabic is not required to enroll. No specific queue length published; uses ventelisten.net for sign-up.

fees.notes: No fee tiering by grade was found (same rate for all grades). Additional yearly materials fee of 1,000 kr (billed in August). Administration fee is listed as 0 kr. Arabic is taught as a subject alongside Danish-medium instruction of standard subjects; not confirmed as full dual-medium instruction.

schools.name: Børne U.N.I.
schools.profile: Børne U.N.I. (Børneuniversitetet på Vesterbro) is a 'lilleskole' (member of Lilleskolernes Sammenslutning) in central Copenhagen using project- and design-based, child-driven pedagogy with age-mixed learning groups, grades 0-9 (~300 pupils).
schools.waitlist: No open places currently available ('Vi har ingen ledige pladser pt.' stated on the admissions page as of research date). Joining the waitlist costs 400 kr.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child pays 85% of school/SFO fees, 3rd child pays 60%, 4th child pays 60%.
fees.notes: The single monthly fee explicitly covers both schooling AND SFO/afternoon care for all grades regardless of actual SFO use, so no separate SFO figure is published — hence sfoMonthlyDKK is null rather than bundled incorrectly. In addition to the 400 kr waitlist fee, a 9,000 kr deposit is required (2,000 kr on confirmation of a place + 7,000 kr due the following April 1), refundable on withdrawal under conditions. The school's own live payment page explicitly states these rates are for skoleåret 2023-2024 — no more recent figure was found online, so this may be outdated; treat with caution and verify directly with the school. Income-based fee subsidy ('fripladstilskud') is available.

schools.name: Waldorf Skolen i København
schools.profile: Waldorf (Steiner) school in Copenhagen offering anthroposophic pedagogy for grades 1-9, with emphasis on arts, crafts, rhythm, and holistic child development; runs an affiliated Soria Moria kindergarten for younger children.
schools.gradesOffered: 1-9 (plus affiliated Soria Moria kindergarten for pre-school ages)
schools.waitlist: 250 DKK/year fee to hold a place on the kindergarten-class waiting list; school 'endeavors' to give sibling priority but does not guarantee it.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,779 DKK/month; 3rd child: 1,442 DKK/month
fees.notes: Fees charged in 11 installments (Aug-June); indexed annually each Aug 1. One-time 5,000 DKK enrollment fee (charged Dec) plus a separate 10,000 DKK refundable parental capital deposit (charged March, refunded when last child leaves). SFO (0.-3. klasse) 1,395 DKK/month. external.notes: Steiner/Waldorf school; prøvefri (exempt from FSA) under friskoleloven §8a stk. 6, as stated in the tilsynserklæring — no exam results. schools.name: Frederik Barfods Skole
schools.profile: One of Denmark's oldest independent primary schools (founded 1834), named after the 19th-century Grundtvigian historian/politician Frederik Barfod. Offers grades 0.-9. with personalized learning plans, an anti-bullying strategy, and a 'Move Yourself' PE-focused program for older students.
schools.waitlist: Free to register on the school's waiting list (no signup fee).

fees.notes: fbs.dk itself could not be fetched directly (TLS/cert mismatch pointing to skoleintra.dk, and skoleporten pages return 403 to automated fetches), so figures come from indexed page content. The 'Indmeldelse og venteliste' page indicates 1,900 kr/month over 12 months and a 1,500 kr deposit due at start of 0. klasse or mid-program entry. An older/cached snippet from a different page suggested 1,300 kr/month school fee and 1,300/700 kr SFO, which may be outdated - not used as primary figure. SFO price could not be confirmed with confidence, left null. Fee covers most costs except grade 4-9 computers and class trips.

schools.name: Kaptajn Johnsens Skole
schools.profile: Private independent primary school (friskole) in Frederiksberg with the motto 'Tryghed - Læring - Ordentlighed' (Safety - Learning - Decency). Grades 0.-9. No distinct alternative pedagogy (e.g. Montessori/religious) identified; academically high-performing (average grade ~9.4, well above national average).
schools.waitlist: Admission via the national waitlist system at ventelisten.net/147018; school also publishes a 'Vejledning til venteliste' guide.

fees.notes: NOT FOUND: exact fee figures could not be confirmed. The school's Skolepenge page confirms fee documents exist ('Fordelingsnøgle skolepenge 2026-27', 'Fordelingsnøgle SFO-betaling 2026-27', 'Ansøgningsskema 2026-27' for subsidy applications) but these are Cloudflare/JS-protected 'Fullscreen' documents that returned 403 Forbidden to all automated fetch attempts (direct and via reader proxy). An unverified third-party aggregator (proff.dk) surfaced a '25,200 kr' figure in a search snippet, but this could not be corroborated against the school's own materials (unclear if annual/monthly or even the correct metric), so per instructions it was NOT used - left null rather than guessed. Site appears active and is a legitimate, currently operating private primary school (434 students, grades 0-9).

schools.name: Frederiksberg Friskole
schools.profile: A Grundtvig-Kold tradition friskole ('børneskole') built around 'levende vekselvirkning' (living interaction) and 'livsoplysning' (life enlightenment), emphasizing respect for childhood as valuable in itself rather than mere preparation for adulthood.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,167 DKK/month; 3rd child: 655 DKK/month (tiered reduced fees rather than a percentage discount).
fees.notes: As a 'børneskole' the school does not offer classes past 7. klasse. Fee includes books and materials; a 100 DKK class fund is charged each August; withdrawal requires 1 month's notice. SFO (808 DKK/month, 12 installments) runs 14:00-16:30 and covers roughly 0.-5. klasse. School year for these prices not explicitly stated on the fetched page (site fetched live, so figures are presumed current). Page could only be reliably read via a reader-proxy fetch; direct WebFetch was blocked by the site's bot-protection (403).

external.notes: NOT CHECKED: school website is hosted on skoleporten.dk, which returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot challenge) to curl and WebFetch. Needs manual browser check for tilsynserklæring, UMV and whether the school sits FSA.

schools.name: Hovedstadens Privatskoler, Jakobskolen
schools.profile: A Christian private school on Frederiksberg built around 'fordybelse' (deep focus/immersion) and 'fællesskab' (community); motto 'Et trygt sted at være - et trygt sted at lære' (A safe place to be, a safe place to learn).
schools.waitlist: Admission via separate application pathways for preschool/0. klasse vs. already-established grades; early entry to 0. klasse possible via individual assessment for children turning 5 before Oct 1.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1,545 DKK/month school fee, 1,085 DKK/month SFO; 3rd and subsequent children: 1,085 DKK/month school fee.
fees.notes: Page explicitly states 'Skolepenge pr. måned for skoleåret 2026-27 (i 12 mdr.)'. No enrollment/registration fee was found on the priser page. Families experiencing financial hardship can apply for 'økonomisk friplads' (need-based tuition assistance). SFO covers grades 0-3; a separate 'Fritidsklub' exists for grades 4-9 (price not found).

schools.name: Johannesskolen
schools.profile: An ecumenical, non-denominational Christian private school ('folkekirkeligt grundlag') founded in 1910 by the Christian School Association (Den Kristelige Skoleforening). Grades 0.-9., organized into lower (0.-3.), middle (4.-6.) and upper (7.-9.) school units, with a strong Cambridge English program alongside the standard Danish curriculum.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child pays 75% of the fee for their grade level; 3rd and subsequent children attend free.
fees.notes: monthlyFeeDKK of 1,955 DKK/month applies to grades 0.-3.; grades 4.-9. are 2,155 DKK/month (higher tier). Fees are billed in 11 monthly installments (July free). Enrollment costs: 500 DKK fee charged when the child starts, plus a 3,000 DKK deposit paid in two 1,500 DKK installments (2 years and 1 year before start). SFO priced in 4 tiers by weekly hours: Tier 1 (1-9h) 1,045 DKK, Tier 2 (10-13h) 1,390 DKK, Tier 3 (14-18h) 1,835 DKK, Tier 4 (19h+) 2,235 DKK/month, 11 payments/year; summer SFO 135 DKK/day. Monthly camp-school (lejrskole) surcharges apply for grades 3, 5, 7, 8-9 (75-150 DKK/month, July free). Note: an older cached search snippet showed different figures (grades 0-6: 2,030 DKK, grades 7-9: 2,130 DKK) - the directly-fetched current site (johsskolen.dk, dated for school year 2026/27) was used as the primary, more current source instead.

schools.name: Hareskovens Lilleskole
schools.profile: A Danish friskole ('lilleskole') emphasizing that creativity, personal/social development and high academic standards reinforce one another; organized in three divisions (Lilleafdeling 0.-3.kl, Mellemafdeling 4.-6.kl, Overbygning 7.-9.kl) with project- and workshop-based teaching.
schools.waitlist: Admits two bh.kl. (0th grade) classes per year as of Aug 2024; see school's admissions page for waitlist procedure.

fees.siblingDiscount: 340 kr/month reduction for 2nd child; 580 kr/month reduction for 3rd child (same address)
fees.notes: Fee tiered by division and rises with grade: bh.kl-3.kl: Skole 779 + FTO(after-school) 1.798 + madordning (lunch+morning snack) 668 + eftermiddagsmad 31 = 3.276 kr/month total; 4.-6.kl: Skole 2.125 + Klub 452 + madordning 668 + eftermiddagsmad 31; 7.-9.kl: Skole 2.608 + madordning 668 (no club). monthlyFeeDKK/sfoMonthlyDKK above reflect the bh.kl-3.kl (1st grade) tier. Also: 300 kr/year support-association fee per family, plus trip-related costs (field trip meal money, ~100 kr/year transport, and ~one month's skolepenge for 7-8th grade overseas trips). Income-based payment plans/partial scholarships available on request.

schools.name: Ballerup Ny Skole
schools.profile: A small (~190-pupil), non-denominational independent school ('en skole for livet') that treats academic, social, emotional and creative development as equally important, built on a strong sense of community.
schools.waitlist: Open waitlist; parents are explicitly invited to register children for current and future class cohorts.

fees.siblingDiscount: 30% off base fee + SFO for 2nd child; 50% off for 3rd and subsequent children
fees.notes: Grades 0-3: skole 1.249 kr + SFO 1.249 kr + fruit/meals 520 kr = 3.018 kr/month total. Grades 4-9: skole 2.498 kr (SFO/klub folded in) + fruit/meals 520 kr = 3.018 kr/month total (so total monthly cost is the same across all grades, only the split differs). Enrollment fee scales by grade at entry: 0.kl 2.505 kr, 1.kl 4.370 kr, 2.kl 4.632 kr, 3.kl 4.911 kr, 4.-9.kl 5.204 kr (non-refundable). All fees index ~2%/year each 1 January.

news.title: Sophie sørgede for sejr

schools.name: Thomasskolen
schools.profile: A Christian independent school (kristen friskole) with an open Christian foundation, combining a high academic level, a creative environment and an inclusive community; core values include authenticity, engagement, community, Christian faith, joy of life and security.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1.550 kr/month school fee; 3rd child: 760 kr/month; 4th+ child: 170 kr/month (reduced SFO rates for siblings too)
fees.notes: School fee paid over 11 months (July exempt). SFO has two components for 1st child: morning (7:00-8:10) 400 kr/month + afternoon (13:05-17:00, Fri to 16:30) 1.600 kr/month (afternoon figure used as sfoMonthlyDKK; add morning if used). Sibling rates lower for both morning and afternoon SFO. Additional one-off camp costs spread over the year: ~1.500 kr total in 4th grade (5th-grade camp) and ~3.500 kr total in 7th-8th grade (international trip). Note: school's main domain thomasskolen.dk was unreachable during research; data taken from mirror site thomasskolen.com and a skoleintra document listing 2025/26 figures.

schools.name: Michael Skolen (grundskolen)
schools.profile: A Rudolf Steiner (Waldorf) school founded in 1976, aiming to develop students' individual life choices through combined intellectual, practical and artistic competencies; the grundskole is exam- and grade-free, treating learning and personal development as intertwined.
schools.gradesOffered: 0-9 (grundskole); school also continues to 10. klasse and a Steiner HF upper-secondary track
schools.waitlist: Admission via a waitlist (venteliste); registration required before a place is offered.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 1.396 kr/month; 3rd and subsequent children: school-fee-free (only a voluntary 100 kr/month gift contribution)
fees.notes: Enrollment fee (1.896 kr, non-refundable) is charged together with the first month's fee. Separate voluntary monthly 'gift contribution' on top of fees: 165 kr (1st child), 105 kr (2nd), 100 kr (3rd+). SFO figure (1.098 kr/month) applies to grades 1.-3. Located on the Herlev/Ballerup border; kindergarten (Brombærhuset) is technically in Ballerup municipality.

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynserklæring 2025/26 (supervisor Annelise Dahlbæk): pupils' standards meet expectations for the observed grades; Danish, maths, English and overall provision meet folkeskole standards; school prepares pupils for life in a free, democratic society.

external.notes: Rudolf Steiner school; prøvefri (exempt from FSA) under friskoleloven §8a stk. 6 per the tilsynserklæring — no exam results. Published wellbeing surveys on site relate to the HF department (ETU/elevtrivselsmåling) or are old (9th-grade UMV 2019), so none recorded for the grundskole. Tilsyn reports back to 2004 on https://michaelskolen.dk/tilsynsrapporter/.

schools.name: Sct. Joseph Søstrenes Skole
schools.profile: A Catholic private primary school in Charlottenlund/Gentofte, part of Denmark's network of Catholic parish schools, building its work on the Catholic-Christian view of humanity and education ('menneskesyn' and 'dannelsesideal'); SFO is called 'Spiren'.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: full price; 3rd child: 50% of the fee; 4th child: free (per current sjss.dk page).
fees.notes: Current official site (sjss.dk/ny-elev) states 2,480 DKK/month for the 1st/2nd child (12 months/yr), 2,580 DKK/month for grades 7-8, SFO 1,680 DKK/month; sibling discount 2nd child full price, 3rd child 50%, 4th free; enrollment/admin fee 1,000 DKK. An older, differently-worded page on the retired sct-joseph.skoleporten.dk site (dated 'effective 1 March 2024') showed lower figures — 2,220 DKK/month with sibling discounts of 75%/50%/0% and SFO at 1,640 DKK — which appear to be superseded. The exact label of the current school year was not explicitly stated on the page; assumed 2025/26. Grades offered (0.-9. klasse) not explicitly confirmed on the fetched pages — inferred from the standard structure of Danish Catholic parish schools; the 'grades 7-8' fee tier confirms the school runs at least through 8th grade.

schools.name: Rudolf Steiner skolen i Gentofte, Vidar Skolen
schools.profile: A Rudolf Steiner (Waldorf) school in Gentofte spanning nursery through upper secondary (10th grade plus a 2-year Vidar HF programme), emphasizing equal weight on academics, art, music and crafts, with less focus on grades and traditional testing.
schools.waitlist: Online waiting lists for nursery/kindergarten and for grundskole places; site noted open spots for HF and 10th grade for August 2026 entry.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child pays a reduced rate: 1,591 DKK/month school fee (vs 2,166 for 1st child) and 870 DKK/month SFO (vs 1,573).
fees.notes: Prices shown are for the 2026/27 school year, billed over 11 months/year (July is payment-free). A 1,000 DKK enrollment fee applies to new students joining from certain higher grades onward, per the source wording ('for nye elever i følgende klasser'), rather than to all new entrants. Income-assessed fee reduction ('friplads') is available for both school fees and play-group payments, based on 2025 tax-year income.

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynsrapport 2024/25 (supervisor Annelise Dahlbæk, June 2025): pupils' standards meet expectations for the observed grades and overall provision meets folkeskole requirements; humanities, science and practical/creative areas all ticked "Ja"; no recommendations with a deadline.
inspection.concerns: Ten non-binding recommendations: e.g. many pupils appear passive/little engaged and activity levels vary a lot; teaching relies heavily on question-answer; little genuine differentiation ("all pupils do the same thing at the same time"); year plans rarely specify concrete learning goals; make student-council work visible; consistent rules on consequences for disrespect/lateness; remove internal teacher comments from published plans.

external.notes: Steiner school; the tilsyn report states "Nej, skolen er prøvefri" (no FSA) — no exam results. A 2025/26 school tilsyn was not yet posted (the "Tilsynsrapport-2025.pdf" upload is the daycare inspection). A 2024/25 UMV for the middle school is published as charts without extractable numbers. Checkbox answers in this report are graphical (text extraction wrongly shows "Nej"; verified visually as "Ja").

fees.siblingDiscount: Full fee for the 1st and 2nd child; 3rd child 50% of the fee; from the 4th child onward, 33⅓% of the fee per child (applies when siblings attend simultaneously).
fees.notes: Monthly fee is 2,150 DKK for børnehaveklasse (0.) through 5. klasse, rising to 2,500 DKK/month for 6.-9. klasse, effective from 1 January 2026, billed 12 months/year; school year runs 1 August-31 July, so this rate applies mid-way through the 2025/26 school year and into 2026/27. schools.name: Den Lille Skole
schools.profile: Denmark's oldest 'lilleskole' (founded 1949/1950 by parents opposed to folkeskole pedagogy). A small progressive free school where community and artistic subjects (music, theatre, art, movement, cooking) are prioritized alongside core academics; the after-school club (Klubben) is pedagogically integrated with the school day.

fees.siblingDiscount: 20% reduction for 2nd child, 50% reduction for 3rd child and beyond
fees.notes: Fee is 2,130 kr./month for bh.kl.-9.kl., stated as effective 'pr. 01.01.2025' and billed 12 months/year (grade 9 has a free July). Adjusted annually each Jan 1 by price index; page had not shown a newer 2026 figure as of this research (Sept 2026), so the current rate may be slightly higher. SFO (0.-3. kl.) is 1,340 kr./month, 12 months. Enrollment fee = 1 month's combined skolepenge+SFO for grades 0-3 (≈3,470 kr.) or 1 month's skolepenge only for grades 4-9 (2,130 kr.). School states fees are all-inclusive with no extra activity charges beyond a 9th-grade trip.

news.title: Den Lille Skole i Marstal er sat til salg: - Det er vemodigt, men vi skal ud på nye veje

schools.name: Kvikmarkens Privatskole
schools.profile: Small private school in Gladsaxe/Søborg with no political or religious affiliation, two classes per grade (max 20 pupils/class) from kindergarten to 9th grade. Emphasizes wellbeing, differentiated teaching and solid academic competence alongside democratic/civic formation.
schools.waitlist: Waiting lists exist for several classes, including beginner (0. klasse) classes; early registration recommended. One-time waiting-list fee 300 kr. (non-refundable).

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child school fee 1,800 kr/month; 3rd+ child 1,690 kr/month; SFO 2nd+ sibling 1,050 kr/month
fees.notes: Fees paid over 12 installments, August-July, for 2026. Camp-school (lejrskole) parent contributions capped at 1 month's fee for grades 0-8, 2 months for grade 9. Students must supply their own PC from 4th grade onward. 384 pupils.

schools.name: Gladsaxe Privatskole
schools.profile: Non-denominational, non-political mainstream private school with one class per grade level (bhkl.-9. kl.), roughly 20 pupils/class. Focuses on pupil wellbeing as a precondition for learning, aiming to form 'life-skilled, responsible' children via seven core competence areas.
schools.waitlist: No formal waitlist described; school instead lists 'ledige pladser' (available places) and an online enrollment/sign-up form, with an 'admission procedure' (procedure for indmeldelse).

fees.siblingDiscount: 25% off 2nd child (school fee 1,641 kr; SFO 1,024 kr); 50% off 3rd child (school fee 1,095 kr); school offers a 'søskendegaranti' (sibling guarantee)
fees.notes: School fee 2,188 kr/month effective 1 Jan 2026, paid over 12 months. SFO 'Regnbuen' fee 1,365 kr/month effective 1 Aug 2026 (start of 2026/27 school year); children auto-enrolled in SFO from K through July of 3rd-grade year. One-time class-fund contribution of 200 kr. collected in August (or pro-rated mid-year). Extra monthly savings contributions collected in specific grades to fund overnight camp-school trips (grades 3, 6, 9). 183 pupils as of Sept 2026.

schools.name: Bagsværd Friskole
schools.profile: A friskole in the Grundtvig-Kold free-school tradition (based on its stated values), emphasizing community ('fællesskab'), creativity, storytelling and student/class democracy. Organized into indskoling, mellemtrin, and overbygning (grades 7-9).
schools.waitlist: Admission handled via a waiting list at Ventelisten.net (school code 159018); a non-refundable 475 kr. administration fee is charged at sign-up; an information meeting is held in Sept/Oct the year before a child is due to start.

fees.notes: Could NOT confirm current monthly tuition despite extensive attempts. The school's fee page (bagsvardfriskole.dk/skolepenge) was archived by the Wayback Machine as recently as July 2025 but returns HTTP 404 on the live site now (Sept 2026), indicating the site was restructured/redesigned and the fee page removed or moved to a non-guessable URL; no dropdown/JS-rendered sub-navigation for 'Til Forældre' could be retrieved via static fetch. Third-party aggregators (skolegang.dk, privateskoler.dk, uddannelsesstatistik.dk) also do not publish this school's fee figures. Only the 475 kr. non-refundable waiting-list admin fee was confirmed (at https://www.bagsvardfriskole.dk/praktisk/venteliste). Do NOT treat the 'Den Lille Skole' or 'Kvikmarken' figures as a proxy — no number should be assumed for this school. Recommend contacting the school directly (44 98 43 35 / kontor@b-friskole.dk) for current pricing. 203 pupils, ~20.2 pupils/class, school not otherwise flagged as closed/merged.

schools.name: Bagsværd Gymnasiums Grundskole
schools.profile: Grundskole (primary/lower-secondary, begynderklasse to 0.g) department of Bagsværd Kostskole og Gymnasium, a private self-governing institution combining a day/boarding grundskole with an STX gymnasium. Academic culture built on community ('fællesskab'), academic rigor ('faglighed') and integrity ('ordentlighed'), with sports/talent tracks (e.g. Science6) from 7th grade.

fees.siblingDiscount: 250 kr./month reduction per child for families with multiple children in the SFO 'Birken' (begynderklasse-3. klasse)
fees.notes: Website bagkost.dk (as given) is the correct, live, current website — it is the site for 'Bagsværd Kostskole og Gymnasium,' of which institution 159034 'Bagsværd Gymnasiums Grundskole' is the primary/lower-secondary department; not dead or misidentified. (The https:// version of bagkost.dk was blocked by the research agent's fetch tool for domain-verification reasons; the http:// version worked and returned identical content.) Fee shown (2,160 kr/month, 25,920 kr/year) is for Begynderklasse-6. klasse, effective 1 Jan 2026; 7. klasse-0.g costs 2,220 kr/month (26,640 kr/year) instead. SFO 'Birken' (Begynderklasse-5. klasse) is 1,650 kr/month plus a mandatory cafeteria/meal charge of 92 kr/month. Enrollment fee 3,000 kr includes 2 months' advance tuition (Aug-Sep). Tuition billed across all 12 months including July. Camp-school trip costs range 1,200-5,600 kr depending on grade (2025 prices). 718 pupils, avg. class size 23.3, average exam grade 8.7/12 (well above national average of 7.2).

schools.name: Atheneskolen
schools.profile: A niche school exclusively for highly gifted children, admission based on documented high cognitive ability (WISC-V testing). Combines academically rigorous, advanced-level teaching (culture, logic, language) with strong emphasis on emotional safety and social belonging for gifted pupils. Moved to new premises on Lundtoftevej near DTU, Kgs. Lyngby, in summer 2025.
schools.waitlist: Waiting-list registration costs 1,500 kr. Admission requires a WISC-V giftedness assessment and typically a 14-day trial period (1,500 kr.); a 14-day pre-school program is also available (1,500 kr.).

fees.notes: No explicit school-year/effective-date was stated on the fee page itself, so feeYear is left null (figures reflect the live site as of Sept 2026). SFO & Mini Club (grades 0-4) is 1,600 kr/month; a separate after-school 'Club' for grades 5-9 costs 540 kr/month. Enrollment/admission fee (optagelsesgebyr) is 1,500 kr.; the school's own fee page also lists a refundable deposit (depositum) of 8,100 kr. An earlier, less reliable web-search summary (not the school's own fee page) mentioned a different 'parental deposit' of 30,000 kr (couples) / 15,000 kr (single parents) — this could NOT be verified directly on the school's site and may be outdated or inaccurate; treat the 8,100 kr depositum from the direct fee-page fetch as the more trustworthy figure. Additional parent costs cited: computers from grade 6 (2,000-10,000 kr), grade 7 trip contribution (2,000-3,000 kr), grade 9 international trip (4,000-5,000 kr). 2025 enrollment data shows pupils in grades 1-9 only (216 total); no 0. klasse cohort was recorded that year, though a pre-school trial program exists. Grade range based on 2025 enrolment snapshot (grades 1-9); could not confirm from the school's own site whether a kindergarten class (0. kl.) is formally offered.

schools.name: Taastrup Realskole
schools.profile: Traditional Christian-founded 'realskole'/friskole in Taastrup, established 'in Christian, Danish spirit', with morning hymn-singing, the Lord's Prayer, Christmas services and mandatory religion class, combined with a strong academic ('realskole') focus and project-based work at higher grades.
schools.waitlist: One-time waiting-list fee ('ventelistegebyr') of 450 kr; contact school directly regarding openings; ~732 pupils across 3 tracks per grade (4 tracks in grades 7 and 9 from 2026/27).

fees.siblingDiscount: 1st child 1,840 kr, 2nd child 1,840 kr, 3rd child 920 kr (50%), 4th child (and beyond) free. Sibling discount only for biological/cohabiting siblings; not available on the pre-school (førskole) rate.
fees.notes: Fee is a flat monthly rate per family position (1st/2nd/3rd/4th child), not tiered by grade — same 1,840 kr/month applies across all grades. SFO billed 12 months/year at 1,952 kr (1st child)/976 kr (2nd)/780 kr (3rd), morning-opening included. Pre-school (førskole) April-June rate 3,792 kr/month, July 1,952 kr. Enrollment/admin fee at registration: 1,050 kr/child + optional FI-card fee. Late-payment fees 50-100 kr. Class fund 2-300 kr/year; partial self-payment for camp/school trips.

fees.notes: IMPORTANT: This school only takes pupils from 7th grade onward — there is no 1st grade, 0. klasse, indskoling or mellemtrin here, so the '1st grade' fee requested does not strictly apply. The monthlyFeeDKK shown (1,780 kr/month, paid over 12 months/year, confirmed structurally on the school's own site) is for its lowest offered grade (7th); the exact kr. amount itself was not found explicitly stated on frb-privatskole.dk (which only describes payment timing/structure) and instead comes from a third-party school-fee comparison article (frederiksbergliv.dk) that could not be fully re-verified (paywalled/JS-rendered) — treat with moderate confidence. Since only grades 7-9 exist, there is no SFO (after-school care is for younger children).

schools.profile: General small private school branded 'Det trygge valg' (the safe choice), emphasizing small classes, individual attention, stable/experienced staff, and nature-integrated learning; spans indskoling through udskoling.
schools.waitlist: High demand — school states 'der er rift om pladserne på vores lille skole' (strong competition for spots); prospective families are advised to call immediately to join the waiting list for popular year groups.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd and 3rd child: 1,014 kr/month (roughly 50% reduction); 4th child free. SFO sibling discount: 800 kr/month for 2nd/3rd child.
fees.notes: 1st child 2,028 kr/month, 2nd/3rd child 1,014 kr/month, 4th child free — all over 12 months. SFO (grades 0.-3.), full-time incl. summer weeks 27/31/32: 1,600 kr/month over 11 months; part-time (max 10 hrs/week): 1,280 kr/month over 11 months. A modest state subsidy is available to reduce fees/SFO payments for families with financial need. Confirmed starting grade is 0. klasse (kindergarten class); exact top grade (9th vs 10th) not fully confirmed but 9th grade Cambridge English program was referenced, implying 9 is the terminal grade.

schools.profile: One-track-per-grade private school in Kastrup/Tårnby (~239 pupils) describing itself as 'a village school in the big city'; a mainstream Danish privatskole with no specific alternative pedagogy or religious affiliation, focused on community, academic standards, character development and mandatory field-school (lejrskole) trips every year 0-9.
schools.waitlist: Admission runs through the external platform ventelisten.net (institution no. 185013); a 500 kr fee is required to be placed on the waiting list, and the child is only registered once payment clears.

fees.siblingDiscount: 450 kr/month reduction for younger siblings, grades 0-9; SFO sibling rate is 1,120 kr/month (vs. standard 1,570 kr/month).
fees.notes: Fee tiers by grade (2026, monthly): 0.-3. klasse 1,940 kr; 4. klasse 2,140 kr; 5.-8. klasse 2,320 kr; 9. klasse 1,880 kr (monthlyFeeDKK above uses the 0.-3. class/1st-grade tier). Number of annual billing installments (11 vs 12) is not stated on the site. Enrollment fee is defined as 'two months' school fees' (2 x 1,940 kr = 3,880 kr using the 1st-grade rate); pupils entering after kindergarten pay an extra 2,900 kr toward camp/lejrskole costs. SFO spring-term (May-June) full-day rate is higher at 3,880 kr/month. No specific pedagogical/religious profile description (e.g., Grundtvigian) was found on the site despite checking the 'profil', 'skolefakta' and homepage pages.

schools.name: Birkerød Privatskole
schools.profile: A well-established, mainstream private school in Birkerød (Rudersdal) covering grades 0.-9. with SFO ('Mini SFO'/SFO) and an older-pupil club ('Klub Bøgen'); runs as a classic Danish privatskole, member of Danmarks Privatskoleforening, without a distinct alternative-pedagogy or religious profile.
schools.waitlist: Publishes a dedicated 'Ledige pladser' (available places) page and a separate 'Friplads' (need-based free-place/scholarship) page; 400 kr fee to be placed on the waiting list.

fees.siblingDiscount: 150 kr/month reduction for a first sibling; 450 kr/month reduction for additional siblings. Does not apply to SFO/Klub fees or the annual book fee (bogpenge).
fees.notes: Fees billed in 11 monthly installments/year. Tiers: grades 0.-5. = 2,000 kr/month; grades 6.-9. = 2,070 kr/month (monthlyFeeDKK above uses the 0.-5. / 1st-grade tier). SFO/Klub is also billed in 11 installments at 1,450 kr/month. Separate annual book fee (bogpenge) due 1 July: 2,000 kr (grades 0-5) / 2,070 kr (grades 6-9) — not included in the monthly figures above. Detailed vision/values pages exist but returned 404/could not be retrieved, so a deeper pedagogy description beyond 'classic mainstream privatskole' was not confirmed from source text.

schools.name: Marie Kruses Skole
schools.profile: A long-established, academically ambitious private school in Furesø offering grundskole (0.-9. klasse), a 10th-grade year, and its own upper-secondary gymnasium (Kruses Gymnasium); emphasizes tradition, community ('fællesskab') and high academic ambitions rather than a distinct alternative pedagogy.
schools.waitlist: No specific waitlist length/capacity information found on the site (a 'Grundskole' navigation section exists but detailed admission/queue info was not retrievable in this research pass).

fees.siblingDiscount: 1st & 2nd child pay full fee; 3rd child gets 33% discount; 4th+ child attends free. SFO ('Kometen'): 2 siblings in SFO get a 400 kr/month reduction; 3rd sibling in SFO is free.
fees.notes: Flat fee applies across all grundskole grades (no grade tiering found), billed 12 months/year. School year 2025/26 rate was 2,285 kr/month, rising to 2,385 kr/month for 2026/27 (figure used above). SFO ('Kometen', for 0.-3. klasse) fee of 2,207 kr/month is effective from 1 January 2026. Enrollment/'startgebyr' equals one month's school fee (non-refundable if the child withdraws before starting) — used the 2026/27 rate (2,385 kr) above. General pedagogy/profile page content could not be retrieved (site repeatedly returned only cookie-consent text); description above is inferred from homepage tagline and grundskole section structure.

schools.name: Rungsted Private Realskole
schools.profile: A classic Danish 'realskole' in Hørsholm spanning a pre-school year (Miniforskolen) through 9th grade, organized into Indskoling (0.-3.), Mellemskole (4.-6.) and Udskoling (7.-9.); a mobile-free campus with emphasis on academic depth, curiosity and wellbeing.
schools.waitlist: Register via 'Skriv dit barn op' online form; as of this research, Miniforskolen intake for 2027 (children born 2021) had 'få ledige pladser' (a few spots left).

fees.siblingDiscount: Built into the fee scale itself: 1st child 2,230 kr/month; 2nd child 2,110 kr/month; 3rd child 1,910 kr/month; 4th child and beyond attend free.
fees.notes: Fees paid in 11 monthly installments in advance, roughly Aug-June (annual totals: 1st child 24,530 kr; 2nd child 23,210 kr; 3rd child 21,010 kr). Separate from the monthly fee, there is a refundable enrollment/security deposit of 6,000 kr per child (returned on departure) plus the 450 kr one-time registration/transfer fee (enrollmentFeeDKK above is the non-refundable 450 kr; the 6,000 kr deposit is refundable and noted here rather than in that field). SFO ('Ønskeøen') fee of 1,733 kr/month applies to børnehaveklasse through 3rd grade. Main domain (rpr-skole.dk without 'www') worked; the 'www.' variant given in the brief returned connection errors.

schools.name: Hørsholm Lille Skole
schools.profile: A 'lilleskole' (small independent school) in Hørsholm run on an explicit pedagogical/value foundation emphasising community and individual learning; not religious or denominational.
schools.waitlist: Registration open from birth via ventelisten.net (venteliste code 223007); school contacts families roughly two years before start; ~22 candidates invited to interview/selection process for BH-klasse; mid-year admission possible via trial days if space allows.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: 2,160 kr/month (school fee), 3rd+ child: 200 kr/month; SFO Snøvsen 2nd child 1,150 kr/month, 3rd+ free
fees.notes: Fee paid all 12 months including 9th grade. One-time indmeldelsesgebyr = 2,440 kr (1 month's fee); separate refundable deposit (indskud) = 4,880 kr (2 months' fee). SFO paid 11 months (July free). A separate after-school club 'Fritidsklub Basen' also exists (1,030/790/free kr per month, 11 months). Tuition covers normal school trips; larger trips (Berlin in 8th grade, international trip in 9th) cost extra (~5,000 kr). Partial fee subsidies (fripladstilskud) may be available depending on state funding pool.

schools.name: Park Allé Privatskole
schools.profile: Independent school (friskole) in Brøndbyvester — the municipality's only free primary school. Older sources (~2017-18) describe it as built on 'Asian values' with Chinese-language/culture teaching; the current (2026) site instead foregrounds a 'kampkunst' (martial arts) concept built on five dojo-kun principles (honesty, diligence, respect, self-control, striving for good character), combined with global-citizenship education and some Grundtvig-inspired language about joy in learning. Ambassador school for Save the Children (Red Barnet).
schools.waitlist: Admission via waitlist; priority order is gender balance, then siblings of currently enrolled students, then staff children, then waitlist date. Waitlist registration fee 460.50 kr (one-time, via a 'Tilmelding til venteliste' purchase on the school's Shopify-based site). Site content indicated open seats in 7th and 8th grade.

fees.notes: No skolepenge/priser/betaling page exists anywhere in the site's full page sitemap (33 pages checked) — monthly fee, SFO fee, sibling fee-discount and enrollment/indskud figures were not found published online; families would need to contact the school directly for current pricing. Not closed — site is active and current (references autumn 2026 dates and a June 2027 open house).

schools.name: Københavns Skole & Idrætsakademi
schools.profile: Private school in Copenhagen combining standard grundskole academics with a sports-academy track (football, tennis, ice hockey), emphasising talent development for 'body and mind'.
schools.waitlist: Applicants must be on the school's waitlist, then pass a sport-specific trial-training/testing period plus an admission interview (and a motor-skills test for younger 'indskoling' applicants) before acceptance.

fees.year: 2026/27 (implied; page itself only says 'indeværende skoleår'/current school year without an explicit label, but elsewhere references skoleåret 2026/2027)
fees.notes: 12 monthly payments Aug-Jul, continuing even for students leaving after 9th grade. Deposit of 3 months' tuition (6,450 kr) due on acceptance, refunded only if the student completes through 9th grade; forfeited otherwise. One-time non-refundable 750 kr fee covers application administration, admission interview and sports assessment testing. Mandatory 'fruit fee' of 29 kr/month is added automatically (11 months, not charged in July) and cannot be opted out of. Late fees apply: 100 kr per payment reminder, +50 kr/instalment if not paid via PBS. No SFO/after-school care was found mentioned anywhere on the site.

schools.waitlist: Applications via ventelisten.net; 300 kr non-refundable admin/Skolekreds membership fee; mandatory info meeting required to proceed; siblings of enrolled pupils prioritized; school picks 'best match' for a vacancy rather than following strict waitlist order.

fees.siblingDiscount: 750 kr/month reduction per additional child from same household

Limited income-based fee subsidies available (apply by 1 Sept). Languages/curriculum not explicitly stated on site; assumed standard Danish as no bilingual/international program is mentioned.

schools.gradesOffered: 0-2 currently, expanding year by year (school appears newly founded, admitting one new cohort per year; interest list open for 0. klasse intakes through 2033)
schools.waitlist: Two-stage process: an 'interesseliste' (interest list) fee of 500 kr/child covers listing for future 0. klasse cohorts (2028-2033 mentioned); admission interviews for currently open spots across several grades are held and filled on an ongoing/rolling basis.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child 2,520 kr/month; 3rd child 2,320 kr/month (vs. 2,920 kr for 1st child)
fees.year: prices as of 1 January 2026 (re-indexed annually each 1 Jan)
fees.notes: Monthly fee INCLUDES mandatory after-school care ('fritidsordning'), so sfoMonthlyDKK is null (bundled, not separate). Paid via PBS on the 1st of the month, 12 payments (school year Aug 1-Jul 31). Beyond the interest-list fee, upon actual acceptance families must pay: 2 months' tuition upfront, a non-refundable deposit of 3,000 kr (used here as enrollmentFeeDKK), and a separate REFUNDABLE deposit of 10,000 kr (returned when the child leaves the school). School day runs 8:45-14:00 for grades 0-2 and 8:45-15:00 for other classes; morning care from 7:30, afternoon care 14:00-17:00 (Fri to 16:30). Grade range is uncertain/in flux since the school seems to be in a multi-year opening/ramp-up phase — verify current grades directly with the school.

schools.name: Unity Skolen
schools.profile: A private school in Glostrup describing a child-centered approach with low student-teacher ratios, character development, and tolerance across 'faith, gender, sexuality and race'; site text also references religion as a source of 'inner peace and strength', suggesting some values/faith dimension, but this is not clearly specified.
schools.waitlist: Online waitlist registration with payment ('Venteliste Unity Skolen' / 'Tilmeld Ventelisten'); a mandatory info meeting ('Infomøde') is offered for interested families.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child and subsequent children pay 700 kr/month (100 kr less than the 1st-child rate of 800 kr)
fees.notes: CAUTION: several subpages (e.g. 'Om Skolen', 'Værdigrundlag') contain what reads like generic/unfinished template marketing copy — including references to pupils 'aged 13-19' and a 'Best School for Science Award 2017' — which do not fit a Danish 0.-9. klasse grundskole and suggest the site may have unreplaced placeholder content on some pages. The fee figures on the dedicated /priser/ page, by contrast, are concrete, in DKK, and phrased in ordinary Danish ('pr. måned i 12 måneder'), so they are more trustworthy than the profile/pedagogy text. Grades offered and religious/pedagogical affiliation could not be reliably confirmed; recommend contacting the school directly or visiting in person to verify profile before relying on it. Fee year not stated (no indication prices are 2026/27-specific).

fees.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for other places (dagtilbud, fritidsinstitution/KKFO/fritidshjem); no sibling subsidy for klub or private fritidsinstitution.

schools.curriculum: Danish (own pedagogical/reform profile; students sit standard Folkeskole leaving exams after 9th grade)
schools.profile: Farum Lilleskole is an independent 'lilleskole' (progressive alternative primary/lower-secondary school) in Furesø, part of the Danish lilleskole movement founded on close relationships, outdoor education (udeskole), musical-creative learning, and shared community between children, staff and parents.
schools.waitlist: Operates an application/waiting-list system; admission proceeds via written application plus an informal 'expectation-alignment' conversation (not a formal interview) between school and family; class composition also weighs siblings, gender balance, wellbeing/dynamics, and application timing.

fees.siblingDiscount: School fee: 2nd child -250 kr/month, 3rd child -250 kr/month, 4th child and beyond free (same registered address). SFO: -200 kr/month from 2nd child onward (same address).
fees.notes: Fees billed monthly in advance, 12 months/year ('Der afregnes for alle årets 12 måneder'). Besides the 3,000 kr (max 5,000 kr per family) enrollment fee, there is also a separate one-time non-refundable registration fee of 500 kr/child, plus a security deposit equal to 3 months of school fees (refunded on withdrawal). SFO fee (1,175 kr/month) includes afternoon meals. 'Klub Åbne Døre' after-school club: 200 kr/month for grades 5-6, 100 kr/month for grades 7-9 (no sibling discount on Klub). An annual 'camp school' (lejrskole) surcharge is also assessed, amount unspecified. Fee is flat/uniform across all grades.

schools.waitlist: Application, questionnaire, interview, trial week, record review. Priority to former Montessori pupils, siblings, children with CPR by 5 September.

fees.siblingDiscount: 2nd child: -300 DKK/month; 3rd child: -500 DKK/month; 4th child: -1,200 DKK/month. Also 3% discount for full-year prepayment and 2% for half-year prepayment.
fees.notes: DKK 3,000/month with CPR before 5 September; 4,800/month without. Afternoon care 1,500; morning care 500. Sibling discounts 300/500/1,200. 3% discount for yearly payment. Number of billed months not stated.

international.curriculum: Montessori (AMI/AMS-trained teachers) integrated with Danish Fælles Mål
international.danishOffering: Danish 3 hours/week in level-based groups (beginner to advanced).
international.accreditation: Approved by Danish Ministry of Education (20 March 2023); AMI/AMS teacher certification
highlights: Denmark's first international Montessori elementary school
Moderate fees
considerations: Young school; Danish only 3 h/week
international.admission: Application, questionnaire, interview, trial week, record review. Priority to former Montessori pupils, siblings, children with CPR by 5 September.

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynserklæring 2024/25 (supervisor Karen Leth): Danish, maths and English standards and overall provision meet folkeskole requirements (English clearly above); supervisor describes a skilled, conscientious offer for English-speaking pupils in an unusually pleasant, safe learning environment.
inspection.concerns: No student council or other democratic pupil body, and pupils had not been encouraged by the head to form one (questions 17-18 answered "No").

inspection.conclusion: Tilsynserklæring 2023/24: overall provision meets folkeskole standards; maths meets standard; calm, inclusive, safe learning environment.
inspection.concerns: Pupils' standard in Danish did NOT meet folkeskole level (taught only as Danish as a second language, 2-3 lessons/week); no student council.

external.notes: Small Montessori primary school (English-language, age-mixed groups); no exams. Site also links an undervisningsmiljøvurdering document (not identified/extracted), årsrapport 2023 and friheds-/folkestyre declarations. Supervisor notes high pupil mobility (children rarely stay several years).
